instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a module that implements a 3-to-8 decoder using only 2-to-4 decoders. You are not allowed to use any other logic gates. The module should have three inputs (A, B, C) and eight outputs (Y0-Y7). The output Y0 should be active when A=0, B=0, and C=0. The output Y1 should be active when A=0, B=0, and C=1. Similarly, the output Y7 should be active when A=1, B=1, and C=1. Write the Verilog module name, input and output definitions below.
label: trojan
